desc: A Mario-only move finds Mario: Petal Meadows' battle 0 with Koops at Super rank; Mario jumps, then Koops' Shell Shield (TARGET_CLASS_ONLY_MARIO, from the partner's side) must target Mario (battle_detect.c logs the count). 0.4.1's versus rule dropped the Mario on the attacked side, so an enemy's Mario-only move (the PM64 bosses') found no one
